This barley plot is big — 2.29 hectares — but I am renting it, so I do not want to spend too much fixing the soil for someone else's land. Last year I used DAP at planting and a little urea when the barley was knee-high, and the harvest was alright, so I will do the same this year if the cooperative brings the bags on time. I will use my own seed from last harvest because improved barley seed is expensive and hard to find at the cooperative, and my neighbors mostly do the same. I have my wife and two older children to help with weeding and harvest, but for ploughing with the oxen and for harvest I will need to hire a few extra hands.
